sources.title: KAVERI 2.0 — India Stack Local project record
sources.notes: Visible date: not shown. Official government project directory record; the page publication date is not shown. It identifies Kaveri online document registration and explicitly lists sale of immovable-property transactions. It also reports a historical 8-hours-to-50-minutes benefit and integrations; those are not current guarantees. The page names Prabhakar H L as AIGR (Computers) and Project Director (KAVERI), Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka. Archive capture not attempted during the official pass on 2026-09-05; limitation.

sources.title: Stamps and Registration
sources.publisher: District Administration, Tumakuru, Government of Karnataka
sources.notes: Visible date: 2026-09-01 in the page's last-updated footer; publication date is not shown. Official district page. It lists the Acts and Rules administered, Kaveri features, and Kaveri/Bhoomi integration. The page contains historical references (including 2011-2013 rollout details), so current Bengaluru routing, fees, and timing remain unestablished. Archive capture not attempted during the official pass on 2026-09-05; limitation.

sources.title: The Registration Act, 1908
sources.notes: Visible date: not shown; the India Code document date is not shown. Section 17(1)(b) text states that non-testamentary instruments creating, declaring, assigning, limiting, or extinguishing rights, title, or interest of value Rs 100 and upwards in immovable property shall be registered. This is a legal applicability rule, not a live Kaveri workflow or fee schedule. Archive capture not attempted during the official pass on 2026-09-05; limitation.

sources.title: The Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957
sources.notes: Visible date: not shown; the India Code consolidated-document publication date is not shown and the search record identifies amendments through 2025. Section 30(b) states that, absent an agreement to the contrary, in the case of a conveyance the expense of providing proper stamp is borne by the grantee. It does not supply a current Bengaluru amount for this case. Archive capture not attempted during the official pass on 2026-09-05; limitation.

claims.text: The Registration and Stamps Department functions under the Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka.
claims.notes: Annual Report 2023-24, IGR departmental-ownership entry, PDF page 96.

claims.text: The Registration and Stamps Department is responsible for registering documents relating to property transactions under the Registration Act.
claims.notes: Annual Report 2023-24, IGR registration-functions entry, PDF page 96.

claims.text: The official KAVERI 2.0 project record lists document registration for sale of immovable-property transactions.
claims.notes: Official project directory description; it does not prove that a current Bengaluru sale deed can be completed online.

claims.text: The KAVERI project record identifies a Project Director for the KAVERI project.
claims.notes: The project record contains the role in its implementing-agency contact section.

claims.text: The KAVERI project record gives the Project Director designation as AIGR (Computers).
claims.notes: The project record displays the Project Director role and AIGR (Computers) designation in the same contact section.

claims.text: The KAVERI project record places the Project Director role in the Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka.
claims.notes: This department name is displayed in the project record's contact details.

claims.text: The Revenue annual report states that Kaveri-2.0 is used for registration.
claims.notes: Annual Report 2023-24, IGR Kaveri-2.0 use entry, PDF page 96.

claims.text: The Revenue annual report states that Kaveri-2.0 is integrated with Bhoomi.
claims.notes: Annual Report 2023-24, IGR Kaveri-2.0 integration list (Bhoomi entry), PDF page 96; department-level documentation, not observation of a particular property.

claims.text: The Revenue annual report states that Kaveri-2.0 is integrated with E-Swathu.
claims.notes: Annual Report 2023-24, IGR Kaveri-2.0 integration list (E-Swathu entry), PDF page 96; department-level documentation, not observation of a particular property.

claims.text: The Revenue annual report states that the department operates District Registrar offices and Sub-Registrar Offices for registration functions.
claims.notes: Annual Report 2023-24, IGR office-structure entry, PDF page 95. It does not identify the correct SRO for any unprovided Bengaluru property.

claims.text: Section 17(1)(b) of the Registration Act, 1908 applies to non-testamentary instruments affecting an immovable-property interest valued at one hundred rupees or more.
claims.notes: Section 17(1)(b). This statutory rule does not determine the current Kaveri route or case-specific eligibility. Case-specific route was not observed. No login- or case-data-bound route was observed in this pass.

claims.text: Section 30(b) of the Karnataka Stamp Act assigns the expense of providing proper stamp for a conveyance to the grantee.
claims.notes: Section 30(b) states this default in the absence of an agreement to the contrary. No current stamp-duty amount is asserted.

claims.text: The official Tumakuru Stamps and Registration page lists automatic calculation of market value as a Kaveri feature.
claims.notes: Historical department feature list; it is not a current Bengaluru valuation result.

claims.text: The official Tumakuru Stamps and Registration page lists automatic calculation of stamp fee as a Kaveri feature.
claims.notes: Historical department feature list; it is not a current stamp-duty amount for this Bengaluru transaction.

claims.text: The official Tumakuru Stamps and Registration page lists automatic calculation of registration fee as a Kaveri feature.
claims.notes: Historical department feature list; it is not a current registration-fee amount for this Bengaluru transaction.

claims.text: The official Tumakuru Stamps and Registration page says Kaveri SMS service sends messages on document registration and stages of mutation.
claims.notes: Historical page text; no current notification or status behavior was observed.

claims.text: The official KAVERI 2.0 project record reports a property-registration time reduction from eight hours to fifty minutes.
claims.notes: Project-reported benefit; no current service-level target or case-specific completion time. This figure was not observed on a login- or case-data-bound route.
